question: Does the frozen R44 switchboard cover every 3-CNF, or is there an explicit 3-CNF outside all authoritative frozen routes?

obstruction.encoded_property: contains the unique width-3 clause falsified by each of the 8 assignments to variables 1,2,3
obstruction.semantic_reason: every assignment falsifies exactly one listed clause

route_exclusions.RENAMABLE_HORN: for every polarity renaming, the cube is invariant as the complete set of sign patterns and therefore still contains a clause with at least two positive literals
route_exclusions.EXACT_WIDTH3_XOR_BUNDLE_TO_GF2_V1: the one variable triple has 8 clauses, not one exact 4-clause parity bundle

successor_rule: A verified obstruction must be preserved as a mandatory regression target for every successor switchboard. A successor may close this obstruction only by an exact polynomially charged route; it must then search for a fresh obstruction rather than promote finite coverage to universality.
